_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The test shrinks the app's tail-first mounting so that a 15-turn conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} spans many chunks: on load only the last few chunks mount (as ".messages-chunk" elements) and older history renders as placeholders ([data-testid="pending-chunk"]). "The counts" are pending = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="pending-chunk"]').length and mounted = document.querySelectorAll('.messages-chunk').length. "The gap" is the messages container's (".messages-container") scrollHeight - scrollTop - clientHeight. To "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}, wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s), then wait until the LAST element matching [data-testid="message"] is visible (its getBoundingClientRect() has a non-zero width and height; allow 30s). The test has already set the shelley.tailFirstTest knob; do not set it yourself. Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. Wait with such steps and a timeout, not with polling loops inside the expression. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable in a separate eval with "expect". Perform the steps in order. The background sweep mounts everything without moving the viewport; the sweep is on.
1. Open the conversation.
2. Record the worst scroll drift during the sweep, not just the endpoint (the follow machinery could mask a jump by re-pinning afterward): in one eval, set window.__maxDrift = 0 and add a "scroll" listener to the messages container that computes drift = Math.abs((el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight) - el.scrollTop) and raises window.__maxDrift to it when larger.
3. Wait until pending is exactly 0, with an eval whose "timeout" is "30s": the sweep replaced every placeholder.
4. Wait until the gap is below 5 (allow 15s).
5. window.__maxDrift must be below 120: the bottom-pinned viewport was not disturbed even transiently.
6. The scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button") must not be visible.

steps.expression: new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const check = () => { const els = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message"]'); if (!els.length) return setTimeout(check, 200); const last = els[els.length - 1]; const r = last.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width > 0 && r.height > 0) return resolve('visible'); setTimeout(check, 200); }; setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('timeout')), 30000); check(); })

(function(){ window.__maxDrift = 0; const el = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); el.addEventListener('scroll', function(){ const drift = Math.abs((el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight) - el.scrollTop); if (drift > window.__maxDrift) window.__maxDrift = drift; }); return 'ok'; })()
